why: Verify player-facing concurrent editor conflict recovery with two real tabs, independently of cross-tab notifications.
verdict: pass for the exercised same-project title-edit conflict
observations: Conflict is visible in the header with Save a copy available.
The newer durable project remains byte-for-byte unchanged through the stale Save and subsequent copy operation.
The stale local definition is preserved exactly in the new project except deliberate copy ID/map ID/title/revision changes.
Both project checkpoints reload exactly in their own tabs.
No console errors or changes to normal-game localStorage.
limits: Title edits on one shared draft, not simultaneous landscape regeneration, releases or run writes.
Opening another editor tab can itself save view/thumbnail state and trigger a conservative conflict; this test accepts preserving both definitions, not seamless co-editing.
